fusions.name: Long Haul Lash
fusions.desc: Throws a weighted cord that deals 8 damage. Its damage rises +5% per tile you have travelled (max +40%). Each kill returns a charge, up to 4.

fusions.name: Drag the Column
fusions.desc: Hauls a wide cone of cord ahead of you, dealing 14 damage to everything caught in it and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Forced Stride
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Second Wind
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 15 stamina. Once every 20 seconds.
